title: Implement mesh to Yggdrasil forwarding/routing logic
description: Add forward function in gateway and node IPv6 routing to prefer RPL for local, forward to Yggdrasil TUN otherwise. Update rpl_dodag, routing table. In C for node.
close_reason: VERIFIED_FIXED: Gateway (Rust) forward_mesh_to_upstream/upstream_to_mesh with is_local_mesh Yggdrasil check. Node hybrid.rs classify/route separates Yggdrasil as External, routes via RPL parent. C router.c classify now returns LICHEN_ADDR_YGGDRASIL for 0x02 prefix, YGGDRASIL case tries gradient/LOADng first then falls through to route_external(). CI build verified.
